campaign.name: OpenAlex literature harvest (issue #2863): reconstruct the board-absent instances of the Tier 1 papers and screen them against the board
campaign.notes: Items S1, L1, L2, L4 and L5 of issue #2863 (L3 was done independently by @MathysRennela with the same result). Every paper in Tier 1 publishes enough to rebuild its instances except the two in-range canonical lifted-product codes, which are in arXiv:2607.28605's own appendix rather than in the Cain et al. paper it cites. The builders here are the reconstruction recipes; the fieldnote fieldnotes/2026-10-07-openalex-harvest-reconstructions.md carries the readings and verdicts. Two filings: [[200,16,17]] (routing code) and [[468,36,20]] (canonical LP); everything else is a negative.
